             IN THE COURT OF APPEALS OF OHIO
                              SEVENTH APPELLATE DISTRICT
                                 COLUMBIANA COUNTY

                                            STATE OF OHIO,

                                             Plaintiff-Appellee,

                                                     v.

                                       JACOB ISAAC DAVIS,

                                        Defendant-Appellant

results.syllabus: Minor misdemeanor traffic citation; speedy trial errors waived due to written waiver of time filed by defendant; state provided discovery requested by defendant so no basis for dismissal as a sanction for discovery violations; trial court did not abuse discretion in granting state a continuance of trial due to unavailability of a witness; verdict is not against sufficiency or weight of the evidence; defendant, representing himself pro se, held to the same standard as a defendant represented by counsel; appellant's brief violated Rules of Appellate procedure; judgment affirmed.
